sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Eb]This little light of mine, I'm [Fm]going to let [Eb/Bb]it shine, [Ab](shine)
[Cm]This little [Gm]light of [Ab]mine, I'm going to let it shine, [Gm](shine)
[Eb]This little light of mine, [Gm]I'm going to let [Cm]it shine,
[Eb/Bb]Let it [Bb7]shine, let it shine, let it shine.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb]Every where I go, I'm [Fm]going to let [Eb/Bb]it shine, [Ab](shine)
[Cm]Every [Gm]where I [Ab]go, I'm going to let it shine, [Gm](shine)
[Eb]Every where I go, [Gm]I'm going to let [Cm]it shine,
[Eb/Bb]Let it [Bb7]shine, let it shine, let it shine.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Eb]All through the night, I'm going [Fm]to let it [Eb/Bb]shine, (shine)
[Cm]All through the [Gm]night, I'm [Ab]going to let it shine, (shine)
[Eb]All through the night, I'm [Gm]going to let it [Cm]shine,
[Eb/Bb]Let it [Bb7]shine, let it shine, let it shine.
